pages.text: A black hole of mass M radiates as a black body at the Hawking temperature T = ħc³/(8πGMk) - 1.2×10¹⁴ K for 10⁹ kg - and its power grows as 1/M², 356 TW at 10⁹ kg. Fed exactly what it loses, it holds its mass; fed less, it shrinks, burns hotter, and runs away.
$(thing)Set$(): Hole mass, Feed balance.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): The feed is uneven: by ±2%·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): The hole is shrinking faster than it is fed - it is running away; The hole is growing into its own feed; Its radiation is too hot for the shield.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Power follows the Hawking power.
